findings.P1_official_split: Only reports/split_audit.json may supply fitting partitions. It is the exact audit independently validated against committed splits by validate_dataset; source supervision roles must match official assignments.
findings.P2_selection_evidence: FROZEN YAML is insufficient. A recorded selection_artifact_sha256 must match a separately read snapshot. Snapshot binds method/seed/settings/parameter hash, exact official selection groups and samples/provenance, live method source hashes, raw dataset/official split digests, and separately verified INITIAL stage/hash. Its separately checksummed result must contain all isolated selection-source outcomes and candidate probabilities; code recomputes Brier scores and verifies deterministic chosen-parameter rule. All selection hashes/source groups persist in source_bindings before source_accepted can become true.
findings.P2_coverage_values: coverage_curve uses actual residual thresholds in metres with fraction of independent group maxima <= threshold, counts duplicate residuals together, reports empirical coverage at the finite-sample conformal bound and requested coverage separately, and leaves independent test coverage null. coverage.svg labels calibration-set empirical coverage, metre thresholds, group maxima, requested/empirical values and independent test NOT_RUN; coverage.json stores inspectable values.
